app_tagline: Short games to play solo or head to head, built to be shared.
offline: You're offline. Solo play still works, and results sync later.
mode_pass_desc: Two players, one phone. Take turns.
daily_done: You've played today's board. Replays count as practice.
assist_desc: Slows saws, rings, bars and courses to 70%. Assist runs go on their own board.
result_offline: Saved on this phone. It will sync when you're back online.
practice_run: Practice run. Only your first try counts in a challenge.
claim_prompt: Claim a name so your results count and friends can find you.
challenge_need_net: Challenges need a connection. Try again when you're online.
c_body: {name} scored {score} in {game}. Can you beat it?
c_expired: This challenge has expired. Play the game anyway?
c_already: You've played this one. Your first try counted: {score}.
c_yours: This is your challenge. Share it so friends can take it on.
c_revive_body: {name} crashed at {score} in Nyanya Jetpack. Catch the falling tomato within 10 seconds to bring them back.
c_turn_title: {name} wants a game of Water Bugs
c_turn_body: Move by move, through this link. It's your move.
daily_intro: One board per game, the same for everyone in Kenya today. Your first try goes on the Today standings.
journey_done: You've tried every stage. Go for a personal best.
name: Name
name_hint: Use a nickname, not your real name. 3 to 16 letters, numbers, _ or -.
name_bad: This name can't be used. Please choose another.
name_invalid: Use 3 to 16 letters, numbers, _ or -, not starting or ending with _ or -.
recovery_desc: Enter this on another phone to bring your progress with you. Keep it private.
recovery_none: Claim a name to get a recovery code.
restore_desc: This replaces the progress on this phone.
restore_bad: That code didn't match a player.
coins_note: Coins are earned by playing. They can't be bought or cashed out.
lb_empty: No runs yet. Be the first.
lb_friends_empty: Challenge someone and they'll show up here.
turn_link_desc: Move by move. Send a link, they reply when they can.
es_claim_lead: Claim your name to save it on the standings.
es_name_hint: Use a nickname, not your real name.
es_device_note: Your name is saved on this device.
name_digits: Names can't be all numbers or look like a phone number.
name_wait: You can change your name again later. One free change, then once every 14 days.
name_free_change: You have one free name change.
c_hidden: That challenge isn't available any more, but the game is. Have a go.
leave_body: Your score for this run won't count.
report_body: Report a name that is rude, hateful, or someone's real details. We review every report.
lb_unnamed: Claim a name to appear on the standings.
